description: Construct reusable governing context for local deterministic Python refactoring under adopted DESIGN_MODULE. The task family includes changes in realization structure within the accepted design; no particular coding task or answer is provided. Only the four exact primary owners in the source catalog. External owners remain explicit out-of-scope or unknown; do not invent their content.
